%   Units: km, s, rad (internally).  Frame: Earth-centred inertial (ECI);
%   the user rides on the rotating Earth.  Tested design target: R2019b+.
%  SECTION 1 - CONSTANTS AND CONSTELLATION DEFINITION (simulation logic)
%  SECTION 2 - RUN-TIME STATE SHARED BY ALL CALLBACKS (simulation logic)

% A full-tab invisible axes acts as a canvas; every equation is a text()
% object whose 'Interpreter' is 'latex', so no external toolbox is needed.
'$\mathbf{h}_i=\left[-\frac{x_i-\hat x}{\hat r_i},\;-\frac{y_i-\hat y}{\hat r_i},\;-\frac{z_i-\hat z}{\hat r_i},\;1\right]$'}
'$\hat{\mathbf{x}}=[\hat x,\hat y,\hat z,\hat b]^{T},\qquad b=c\,\delta t_u$'}
'c : speed of light,  \deltat_u : receiver clock bias', ...
%  SECTION 5 - GUI DESIGN: "MATLAB Functions" tab (live source viewer)
['Implements the satellite position equation. Mean anomaly grows linearly with time, '...
'the in-plane position (a cos u, a sin u, 0) is rotated by the inclination (Rx) and the '...
'RAAN (Rz). The code is vectorised over all 24 satellites, so one call returns an N-by-3 matrix.']
['Implements the pseudorange equation. vecnorm gives the geometric range |s_i - u|; the '...
'receiver clock bias b = c*dt_u (in km) and Gaussian noise (randn) are added to every range.']
['Implements the linearised least-squares solver. Each iteration builds H (unit line-of-sight '...
'vectors plus a column of ones for the clock), forms the residual dRho, and solves '...
'dx = H\dRho. MATLAB backslash solves the least-squares problem with QR, which is more '...
'stable than inv(H''*H)*H''*dRho. Iterates until the position step is below 0.1 mm.']
['Implements GDOP = sqrt(trace(inv(H''*H))) and PDOP (position block only). Small values mean '...
'good satellite geometry; position error is roughly PDOP times the range error.']
['Implements the elevation equation using the local vertical (u/|u|) and asind. Satellites '...
'below the elevation mask are excluded from the pseudorange set and drawn grey.']
['Moves the user along a gently curving great-circle-like path. Speed and heading give '...
'latitude/longitude rates; longitude is divided by cos(lat) so the ground distance is correct.']
['The nested simulation step called once per animation frame: advance time, move satellites '...
'and user, determine visibility, generate pseudoranges, solve for position, update histories, '...
'and refresh every graphics object and the status panel.']
